text: 河南省在深圳成功发行政府债券560.04亿元。新增一般债券78.46亿元，用于基础设施项目建设。新增专项债券380.12亿元，其中：92.8亿元用于补充地方政府性基金财力；84.38亿元用于存量政府投资项目；202.94亿元用于土地储备、保障性安居工程、市政和产业园区基础设施和生态环保等重点领域的391个建设项目。再融资专项债券101.46亿元，用于置换存量隐性债务。（界面）
text_en: Henan Province successfully issued 56.004 billion yuan of government bonds in Shenzhen. New general bonds totaled 7.846 billion yuan, used for infrastructure project construction. New special bonds totaled 38.012 billion yuan, of which 9.28 billion yuan was used to replenish local government fund financial resources; 8.438 billion yuan was used for existing government investment projects; and 20.294 billion yuan was used for 391 construction projects in key areas such as land reserve, affordable housing projects, municipal and industrial park infrastructure, and ecological environmental protection. Refinancing special bonds totaled 10.146 billion yuan, used to replace existing hidden debt. (Jiemian)
